title: Human validation and repair loop
problem: ChampCity A/I needs a Human Validation step that records Operator validation results after Builder Report capture and creates a repair handoff only when validation indicates repair is needed.
goal: Add a Human Validation screen, shared validation record model, validation Markdown renderer, and deterministic repair prompt renderer while preserving Work Cards as non-mutated source artifacts.
userOutcome: The Operator can select a Work Card, optionally associate a Builder Report, record manual validation evidence, save JSON and Markdown validation records, and generate a draft Repair Builder Prompt when validation fails, partially passes, or is blocked.
scope: Add minimal navigation for `Human Validation` alongside the existing Work Card workflow screens.
Allow selecting saved Work Card JSON files from `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Work_Cards/` with `phase-01` as the default phase.
Allow selecting an associated Builder Report Markdown file from `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Builder_Reports/` when available.
Show the selected Work Card ID, title, phase, status, and risk level.
Show a plain-language evidence-chain warning when no Builder Report is selected without blocking save.
Extract or display manual validation checklist text from selected Builder Reports using deterministic text scanning only.

Capture Operator validation fields for result, tested items, passed items, failed items, evidence references, screenshot/file paths, commands run, observed errors, observations, decision, and recommended next action.
Create shared JSON-compatible Human Validation record types.
Save validation records as generated JSON and Markdown under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Validation_Reports/`.
Create a deterministic validation record Markdown renderer with a non-mutating note.
Generate and preview a draft Repair Builder Prompt when validation result or Operator decision indicates repair is needed.
Save generated Repair Prompts under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Repair_Prompts/` when applicable.
Create the WC07 Work Card JSON and Markdown artifacts and the WC07 Builder Report.
Extend lightweight validation coverage for validation records, checklist extraction, repair prompt generation, path safety, and paired Work Card artifacts.
outOfScope: Do not call an LLM API.
Do not evaluate Builder quality deeply.
Do not create a report index.
Do not update Work Card status.
Do not implement Work Card editing.
Do not copy, upload, or manage evidence files.
Do not add OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Featherless, LM Studio, or other provider integrations.
Do not add database, cloud, auth, deployment, MCP, or connector integrations.
Do not perform a broad UI redesign.
Do not refactor unrelated source files.
requirements: Renderer code must not write files directly.
Filesystem writes must be mediated by constrained main/preload IPC.

IPC must normalize and validate paths, reject traversal, reject arbitrary absolute paths, restrict phase folder names and generated filenames to safe values, and save only generated `.json` and `.md` validation records.
Validation records must be saved under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Validation_Reports/` with filenames matching `VALIDATION_REPORT_<work_card_id>_<slug>.json` and `.md`.
Repair prompts must be saved under `planning/phases/<phase-folder>/Repair_Prompts/` with filenames matching `REPAIR_PROMPT_<work_card_id>_<slug>.md`.
Existing validation records and repair prompts must not be silently overwritten.
A Work Card selection is required for saving a validation record.
Builder Report selection is recommended but not required.
Manual validation checklist extraction must use deterministic text scanning only.
Repair prompts must be generated for Fail, Partial, and Blocked validation outcomes and for repair-needed Operator decisions.
Repair prompts must not be generated for Pass, Not Tested, deferred validation, or different-problem decisions.
Different-problem decisions must guide the Operator to open a new Work Card.
WC07 must not edit Work Card JSON or Markdown, change Work Card status, change Work Card `riskLevel`, copy evidence files, push to GitHub, or create release tags.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation shows `New Work Card`, `Architect Prompt Composer`, `Risk Router`, `Builder Prompt Generator`, `Builder Report Capture`, and `Human Validation`.
Human Validation lists saved Work Card JSON files for `phase-01`.
Human Validation lists saved Builder Report Markdown files for the selected phase.
Selecting a Work Card displays its ID, title, phase, status, and risk level.
Selecting a Builder Report displays or extracts manual validation checklist text when present.
No Builder Report selection shows the evidence-chain warning but does not block saving.
The Operator can enter validation result, tested items, pass/fail notes, evidence references, commands run, observed errors, observations, decision, and next action.
Saving creates both JSON and Markdown validation records under `planning/phases/phase-01/Validation_Reports/`.
Fail, Partial, or Blocked validation generates a draft Repair Prompt.
Repair Prompt is saved under `planning/phases/phase-01/Repair_Prompts/` when generated.
Pass validation does not generate a Repair Prompt.
Different problem found guidance tells the Operator to open a new Work Card.
Work Card JSON and Markdown files are not modified.
Builder Report files are not modified.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:work-cards` pass.
validationPlan: Run any new validation script if one is added.
Run `git status --short` and review changed files.
Manually run `npm start` to validate the Electron UI.
risks: Manual Electron UI validation is still required because no renderer smoke test exists yet.
Checklist extraction is intentionally helper-level deterministic scanning and may miss unusual Builder Report wording.
Repair prompt generation must avoid implying Work Card status changes or actual repair execution.
Path safety must remain constrained because validation records are Operator-entered evidence text.
builderInstructions: Verify the repository path before editing.
Read `AGENTS.md`, the WC01-WC06 Builder Reports, the WC04 repair report, and the existing WC01-WC06 Work Card JSON artifacts before implementation.
Keep the pass limited to WC07 Human Validation capture, constrained IPC, validation record saving, repair prompt generation, validation coverage, the WC07 Work Card artifacts, and the Builder Report.
Do not call LLM APIs, execute repair work, evaluate Builder quality deeply, modify selected Work Cards, update Work Card statuses or risk levels, add provider SDKs, or implement unrelated features.
Run the required validation commands and document results in the Builder Report.
Stage only files created or modified for WC07 and commit with `feat: add human validation and repair loop`.
operatorNotes: A Work Card is the smallest buildable unit of work that can be handed to a Builder.
A Work Card should never be authored by the Operator alone.
WC07 captures human validation evidence and creates repair handoff artifacts only when needed.
WC07 must not automatically close, approve, fail, validate, repair, or mutate Work Cards.
This closes the first full MVP feedback loop from Work Card capture through human validation and repair decision.
